p.s: I believe that the people who try new things and take risks in order to be succesfull are exposed to good luck and you should call them just "lucky".
While successful people really are the ones who learn how their knowledege, intelligence and skills can drive them to success.

The diference between people who try new things and take risks from someone who is doing what he knows to do well, in order to be succesfull is that the second ones will manage their success for the long term, while risky ones do n't have the abilities and backround to manage their "suddenly" succes.
I believe and example of this is the founder of Microsot.
He invented a new operational system for computers called windows, back in the 1990s.
I do n't think he just created the most important company in the world by triying a new thing and taking the risk to put some money in that business.

What I believe is that he really knew exactly how to change the computer world by adding a new firendly user interface to Personal Computers ( PCs ), and he anticipated the impact that PCs will have in the life of the human kind.
Also, Microsoft 's founder has been able to be succesful managing his company for the last 27 years, beyond the most furious market competition from their rivals ( Apple, IBM and others ).

If someone suddenly change jobs or follow a new idea, and from being financial advisor, he switchs to the pizza business and invest all his savings in this new business, and suddenly he becomes the most famous pizza chef in the world and makes a lot of money, i would call this person luccky.
